storyCards.headline: Roses: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Outkast's "Roses" reached #9 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #9 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 21 weeks on the chart.

Roses was released in 2003.

Album: Speakerboxxx/The Love Below (2003).
